semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company focuses on stretchable PCBs that utilize liquid metal, which is relevant for flexible electronics but does not directly supply traditional semiconductor components.
summary: SATOSEN specializes in innovative stretchable printed circuit boards (PCBs) that maintain stable electrical performance under repeated mechanical stress. Their technology is particularly suited for applications requiring flexibility and reliability, making it a notable player in the realm of stretchable electronics.
capabilities: Liquid metal integration for electrical conductivity
Demonstrations of mechanical resilience under stress
